userStories.title: The honesty line is decided per claim against the receipts, not silenced by any successful write
userStories.description: Cause (C1, F392): `honesty_lines` fires the nothing-done line only when NO write succeeded (`if not done and claims_work_done(answer)`, receipts.py:291-292, 299-300); one successful store_memory or create_playbook suppresses it for every other claim in the reply (night 12 A697: 'I've reverted the heartbeat' with no call at all, next to a refused playbook write). `COMPLETED_ACTION` (:249-255) has five shapes and no passive or third-person form ('was approved', 'has been sent', 'it's been done', 'Mission launched ✅'); `_NOT_A_REPORT` (:257-258) skips any sentence with I'll/once/when/after/here's/below/the following, so 'I'll just confirm that the card has been approved' passes (eval J-inject-a).
acceptanceCriteria: `receipts.py`: each completed-action sentence of the answer is matched to the turn's done write receipts by verb family (created→create_*, approved/done/closed→update_task_status done or approve_mission, started→in_progress, sent/emailed/posted/published→the send words, saved/noted/remembered→store_memory, updated/changed/renamed/reverted/switched→update_*/configure_*, deleted/removed→delete_*/unassign_*, scheduled→schedule_*/create_playbook, assigned→assign_*); a sentence with no matching done receipt gets the nothing-done line, whatever else succeeded in the turn; the line names the claim it is about when there is one ('Just to be clear: I haven't reverted anything…'). → DONE — new consumers/chatbot/claims_backed.py (200 lines): claims(answer) reads each report of work done for its verb; FAMILIES match it to the turn's done write receipts (created→create_/generate_; approved/closed/completed→approve_ or a card moved to Done; started/launched→start_/execute_/run_/approve_mission/create_mission or 'started'; sent/emailed/posted/published/submitted→the send words, 'sent … back'→a card sent back; noted/remembered/stored→memory; saved→memory or a thing saved; updated/changed/renamed/reverted/switched→update_/configure_/set_; deleted/removed/cancelled→delete_/unassign_/remove_/cancel_ or moved to Cancelled; scheduled→schedule_/create_playbook; assigned→assign_ or 'agent set'; moved→a card move). receipts.honesty_lines takes not_done_line(answer, done_writes): a claim with no done write of its family gets the line whatever else succeeded, naming it when another write went through ('Just to be clear: I haven't reverted anything in this reply…'; several: 'sent or reverted'), the plain line when nothing went through. Judgement calls (the smaller change): a verb in no family ('Done.', 'set up', 'it's now on your board') is backed by any done write, as before; a Composio write backs any claim (its receipt names composio_execute, not GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL); 'done' stays generic. says_nothing_was_done reads any not-done line (is_not_done_line) (8d514e34d).

Passive and third-person shapes join `COMPLETED_ACTION` ('was/were <done-verb>', 'has/have/it's been <done-verb>', '<Subject> launched/created/sent ✅'); the skip list no longer exempts a sentence that also carries a completed-action verb ('I'll just confirm that the card has been approved' is a claim). → DONE — COMPLETED_ACTION (moved to claims_backed, re-exported by receipts) gains 'was/were <verb>', 'it's/that's/they've been <verb>' and '<Subject> launched/created/sent ✅'; a passive state is no claim ('was based on', 'was designed to': _STATES). _NOT_A_REPORT is split: a plan word (I'll/once/when/after/if/until/before) exempts only the claim it introduces within two words ('Once I've sent it', 'When the card has been approved'), so 'I'll just confirm that the card has been approved' is a claim; the reply's own content (below/here's/the following) and a past time (yesterday/ago/previously/last week) still exempt their sentence (8d514e34d).

userStories.title: An agent's send on a ticket Auto wrote waits for the owner's click (Decision D7)
userStories.description: Cause (X1, F385): the session/CLI path runs `composio_execute` through `UnifiedToolExecutor.execute_tool` with a caller context that never carries a driving user (services/session_tools.py:766-788: 'A session speaks as its AGENT, never a human operator'); `asks_before_a_send` (owner_only.py:147-165) asks only when `human_driven(ctx)`, and the policy plane is off by default (config.py:958). Night 12: ticket 2318 (#1041), created by Auto from chat with 'Confirm the order with the supplier', started 03:30:52Z; CHRISTMAS BOX (cli) ran GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL at 03:31:51Z (tool_execution_logs 24215), 57 s later, before the owner's 'nothing goes to Kerbside' landed. Gerard, 8 Oct: an agent's send/publish/order on a ticket Auto created from chat raises the same card; tickets a human wrote run as today.
acceptanceCriteria: In the session path, a Composio send/publish action (`owner_only.is_composio_send`) on a ticket whose row says Auto created it from chat (created_by_type 'agent' and created_by_id the workspace's orchestrator agent; a human-created ticket is unchanged) does not execute: it raises the grant card through `asks_before_a_send`/`send_ask` with the card text of FX-008 (recipient, subject, first line), the ticket goes to `blocked` naming the card (the way `_run_ask_human`/`raise_session_ask` parks a ticket on a question), and the agent's tool result says 'Card raised: send <subject> to <recipient>. Nothing goes out until the owner clicks; finish your report and end your turn.' → DONE — 8a4d3cca2: owner_only.asks_before_a_send now asks for an agent's Composio send/publish (is_composio_send) when the run works on Auto's brief (_whose_click → modules/tools/discovery/agent_sends.autos_ticket: a ticket with created_by_type 'agent' and created_by_id the workspace's Auto, Agent.slug auto-<ws> + is_system_agent; workspace-scoped). The session path carries its ticket for composio_execute (session_tools.CARD_ATTRIBUTED_TOOLS → session_task_id in _caller_context, server-built, no user). The card is send_ask's FX-008 text (to / subject / first line); the grant is marked details.agent_send (lane, ticket, agent, recipient, subject); a session's ticket gets an open entry on its ask ledger (kind send), so its turn end parks it blocked with 'Waiting for your click on its send card (approval #N): nothing has gone out' (session_plans.park_reason); the agent reads 'Card raised: send <subject> to <recipient>. Nothing goes out until the owner clicks; finish your report and end your turn.' The marker and the park run in a savepoint, then the tool's own commit (api/session_tools leaves a writing tool to commit). The same send asked on a second ticket reuses the pending grant and is told it already waits on the first ticket (the first keeps its card).

The owner's click runs the send once (`_resume_tool_call`, single-use grant), writes the outcome on the ticket as a note ('Sent on the owner's click at <time>: <recipient>, <subject>') and moves the ticket back to its previous status; a denied card fails the ticket with the reason. → DONE — 8a4d3cca2: api/approval_grants._resume_tool_call first calls agent_sends.sends_on_the_click: the stored send re-enters the executor with the ticket in its context, so asks_before_a_send claims the single-use grant (_the_click) before anything goes out; a grant already claimed never sends again; the claim and executed_result are committed before the ticket bookkeeping (a failure after the send is logged, never a 500 that rolls the claim back). agent_sends_click.sent_on_the_ticket appends 'Sent on the owner's click at <YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC>: <recipient>, <subject>' (or 'the send failed … <error>') as a ticket note, then a session ticket parked on THIS card (no other question or plan open) resumes through resume_on_answer (blocked → assigned, the same session picks up with the outcome in its prompt); one in_progress is only recorded (its turn end resumes it); a board run's or playbook's ticket never left its status. _fail_subject calls agent_sends.declined_send: the ticket goes failed with 'The owner declined the send: <subject> to <recipient>'. Judgement call: a Done/Review board ticket whose send is declined is failed too (the send it closed on never went out); a ticket already failed/cancelled is left.

A read action (GMAIL_FETCH_EMAILS, GET/LIST/SEARCH words) never asks; a send on a human-created ticket never asks; a playbook step and a heartbeat on an Auto-created ticket ask the same way (they are agent runs on Auto's brief). → DONE — 8a4d3cca2: a read slug (GMAIL_FETCH_EMAILS, any GET/LIST/SEARCH/… word) is not a send, so it never reaches the ticket check; a ticket a person wrote (created_by_type user) or another agent wrote runs as before. A playbook step asks when its run was started by Auto's platform call (RecipeExecution.triggered_by 'platform_action', PRD-204 S9's Auto-launched run) or its card is Auto's: an API step through playbook_execution_id (a run whose card is missing still asks, fail-closed), a CLI agent's step through its session ticket (source_id recipe:<run>:<step>). A heartbeat carries no ticket of its own (heartbeat_service runs with source heartbeat), so it asks when it works Auto's ticket through the board run (board_task_id) or a session; the gate reads the ticket, not the lane.

userStories.description: Cause (F1, F2, F393): on the local edition `store_memory` gets no owner because the caller context carries a `user_id` only from a Clerk id (consumers/chatbot/service.py:215-219; modules/tools/discovery/platform_executor.py:1282-1284), and a `scope: private` row with no owner is visible to nobody (injection_filter.py:61-76). userStories.title: One answer on the screen, never two and never none: the retraction names what was streamed, a blank retry never replaces an answer
userStories.description: Cause (G1, G2): `_note_round` retracts `streamed_rounds[-1].content` (consumers/chatbot/service.py:2054-2070) but that content can differ from what was streamed (think tags stripped in core/llm/reasoning.py:21-36; the owner-words rewrite runs per delta live and again on the whole text, core/llm/owner_words_stream.py:140-160; the apology stripped in nudges.py); the frontend deletes the last exact occurrence (frontend/lib/chat/narration.ts:17-21) and, when it does not match, leaves both (A108, A209, A622). The F205 retry and `kept_if_blank` (service.py:2151-2170; modules/tools/execution/nudges.py:216-230) can keep the original answer after its retraction was already sent, leaving the screen empty (eval M-terms-a turn 2).
acceptanceCriteria: The server records, per round, the exact text it streamed (the concatenated deltas after every live rewrite) and retracts THAT text, so `withoutNarration` always matches; a rewrite that happens after streaming never changes what is retracted.

A retraction is sent only when a non-blank replacement follows: `kept_if_blank`/the F205 retry decide first; when the original stands, no retraction frame is sent and the saved answer equals the screen.
